_comment_2: This file allows you to customize plugin-defined skill activation rules

overrides._comment: Customize specific skills. Keys MUST include namespace (e.g., 'claude/skill-creator')
overrides._example: Uncomment and modify the examples below

_claude/skill-creator.description: Override: Make skill-creator critical priority for this project

promptTriggers._comment: Add project-specific keywords. This REPLACES the entire promptTriggers object (shallow merge).

_comment_disabled: Array of skill IDs to completely disable. Use full namespace/skill-name format.

global._comment_maxSkillsPerPrompt: Limit number of suggestions per prompt. Set to number (e.g., 3) or null for unlimited. When more skills match, only top N (by priority) are shown.
global._comment_priorityThreshold: Minimum priority to show. Options: 'critical' | 'high' | 'medium' | 'low' | null. Skills below this threshold are filtered out.

_examples._comment: With these settings, only the top 2 high-or-higher priority skills would be shown

_use_case_1_increase_priority._description: Make a skill more prominent in your project

_use_case_3_disable_skills._description: Turn off skills you don't use

_note_1: Shallow Merge Strategy: When overriding 'promptTriggers', the ENTIRE object is replaced (not deep merged)
_note_3: Validation: Invalid skill IDs in overrides or disabled will show warnings but won't crash the hook
_note_4: Performance: Keep overrides minimal for best performance (<50ms target)
